columns.name: Diabetes_binary
columns.description: Target label.

columns.name: HighBP
columns.description: Binary diagnosed-risk indicator. Indicates if the individual was told by a health professional that they have high blood pressure.

columns.name: HighChol
columns.description: Binary diagnosed-risk indicator. Indicates if the individual was told they have high cholesterol.

columns.name: CholCheck
columns.description: Binary healthcare-utilization indicator showing whether the individual had a cholesterol screening within the past five years. This measures screening behavior, not disease severity.

columns.name: BMI
columns.description: Body Mass Index. Higher values generally indicate greater obesity-related diabetes risk.

columns.name: Smoker
columns.description: Binary lifetime-smoking indicator. A value of 1 means the individual smoked at least 100 cigarettes.

columns.name: Stroke
columns.description: Binary medical-history indicator. A value of 1 means the individual has previously had a stroke.

columns.name: HeartDiseaseorAttack
columns.description: Binary medical-history indicator for coronary heart disease or myocardial infarction.

columns.name: PhysActivity
columns.description: Binary lifestyle indicator. A value of 1 means the individual performed physical activity during the past 30 days outside their regular job.

columns.name: Fruits
columns.description: Binary dietary indicator for consuming fruit at least once per day.

columns.name: Veggies
columns.description: Binary dietary indicator for consuming vegetables at least once per day.

columns.name: HvyAlcoholConsump
columns.description: Binary heavy-alcohol-consumption indicator.

columns.name: AnyHealthcare
columns.description: Binary healthcare-access indicator showing whether the individual has health coverage.

columns.name: NoDocbcCost
columns.description: Binary healthcare-access indicator showing whether the individual could not visit a doctor because of cost.

columns.name: GenHlth
columns.description: Self-rated health score. Larger values represent worse overall health.

columns.name: MentHlth
columns.description: Number of poor mental-health days during the past 30 days.

columns.name: PhysHlth
columns.description: Count of physically unhealthy days during the past 30 days. A larger value means more days of poor physical health.

columns.name: DiffWalk

value_labels.1.0: Serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs

columns.description: Binary functional-limitation indicator.

columns.name: Sex
columns.description: Binary sex code.

columns.name: Age
columns.description: Ordered age-group code. Larger values represent older age groups.

columns.name: Education
columns.description: Ordered education-level code from 1 to 6. Larger values indicate higher educational attainment.

columns.name: Income
columns.description: Ordered household-income code from 1 to 8. Larger values indicate higher income.
